plugins.name: accommodation-search
plugins.description: Search places to stay through the Amadeus Self-Service API: properties by city or geocode priced for a date range and party size, full detail on one property with guest ratings, and every bookable rate for a stay. GDS and chain hotel inventory - hotels, not apartments; short lets and Airbnb-style listings are not carried by this supplier and it does not replace one that does. Search only, no booking path. Supplier-neutral tool interface with a second supplier reserved. An empty or failed search surfaces as an error rather than as 'nothing available', and an exhausted monthly quota is a distinct failure from both a rate limit and a genuinely empty result.

plugins.name: angel-protocol
plugins.description: Welfare-check escalation for a solo operator: watches ambient proof-of-life signals (movement, wearable sync, chat activity) and walks a staged cascade from a soft chat nudge to direct SMS to emergency-contact notification when the principal goes quiet. Pluggable SMS providers (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, AWS SNS), dry-run mode, and pause controls.

plugins.name: bfl
plugins.description: Quantified-self food and training pipeline: ingests meal photos and captions via vision extraction into the chassis Postgres, enriches entries against USDA FoodData Central, and reconciles daily logs on a heartbeat. Ships its DB migration, a chat backfill trigger, and model benchmarking tooling.

plugins.name: chef
plugins.description: Weekly observational variety report over a photo-logged meal history: distinct plant species against the American Gut 30-per-week finding, protein rotation and monotony, and a gap board of food groups absent from the window. Hard refusals against deficiency claims, supplement advice, calorie targets and micronutrient quantification are encoded in the skill rather than left to judgement. Reads the meal tables written by a companion food-logging plugin and writes nothing back.

plugins.name: content-research
plugins.description: Research a topic and produce a blog-post stub - headline, angle, hook, section skeleton, anchor examples, sources, tone notes - then file it into a staged content pipeline. Checks memory before spending a search, finds the dominant narrative and then the contrarian read underneath it. Ships a filesystem pipeline that works with no external system, plus an optional notes-app adapter. Deliberately produces architecture, never prose.

plugins.name: dating
plugins.description: Dating-app automation for a sandboxed subagent: emulator-driven swipe sessions, CLIP photo scoring against installer-tuned prompts, reverse-image catfish screening, conversation state and directives in Postgres, and hard safety rails (photo verification, scheduling blocks, pause flags, welfare-check integration). Regional gating ships disabled with an empty country list.

plugins.name: image-generation
plugins.description: Generate images from a text prompt through either a local ComfyUI running FLUX.1 (free, private, minutes) or a hosted image API (paid, seconds, better at text inside the image). One CLI, a flag to switch. Ships the ComfyUI workflow graph with a three-node-id contract so the graph can be swapped without touching the script. Credentials come from the environment only; the script never reads a secret off disk.

plugins.name: loom-vision
plugins.description: Process a Loom share URL into multimodal context: downloaded video, sampled frames, and the auto-generated transcript converted to WebVTT + plaintext.

plugins.name: parse-youtube
plugins.description: Turn any public YouTube URL into a timestamped transcript plus metadata. Resolves the video id from every URL shape, pulls manual or auto-generated captions with a configurable language fallback chain, and layers title, channel, duration, description and chapters on top via yt-dlp. Emits JSON for code or timestamp-anchored markdown for a draft. No API key needed.

plugins.name: perplexity-research
plugins.description: Turn a research question into a citation-solid .epub brief: designed scholar-filtered queries through a browser-driven research UI, real citation URLs harvested from the expanded sources panel, a sectioned brief with an inline DOI on every claim and a source-summary table, built with pandoc. Optional deep path appends the full text of every cited article behind a five-rung fallback chain. Delivery targets are pluggable - file, chat, or e-reader.

plugins.name: remarkable
plugins.description: reMarkable tablet integration over the cloud API (ddvk rmapi): deliver briefings and documents OTA, read and write a shared collab notebook page by page, ingest full notebooks to searchable text, plus a health heartbeat that alerts when sync auth breaks.

plugins.name: restaurant-booking
plugins.description: Book a restaurant table from a chat message: parses natural-language intent, drives TheFork via Playwright, soft-confirms with the installer through a Discord reaction before submitting, and can create the matching Google Calendar event. Strongest coverage where TheFork is strong (Lisbon and wider Europe).

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: Privacy-enforced WhatsApp group reading via wacli: a wrapper that only permits reads of explicitly allowlisted group JIDs, blocks every DM and send path, and supports digest and lead-scan workflows without touching private conversations.
